app.reset_due: Reset time reached, waiting for update
app.stale: - open the usage page to update
app.no_data: No data yet: with the browser extension installed, open claude.ai → Settings → Usage. The numbers update every time you open that page.
app.no_uninstall: uninstall.bat not found. Run UNINSTALL.bat from the install package instead.
app.already_running: Claude Usage is already running. Look in the system tray (click ^ to expand).

ps.no_browser: No supported browser found. Open your browser's extensions page manually (for example chrome://extensions or edge://extensions).
ps.install_title: Last step, only once: install the browser extension
ps.install_intro: I opened the extensions page of {name}. Follow these three steps:
ps.step_toggle_right: 1. Top right of the page: turn on 'Developer mode'
ps.step_toggle_left: 1. Left side of the page: turn on 'Developer mode'
ps.step_path: 3. In the window that opens, click the address bar at the top, press Ctrl+V to paste the path, press Enter, then click 'Select Folder'
ps.remove_msg: Opened the extensions page of {name}. Find 'Claude Usage Bridge', click 'Remove', then confirm.
ps.ff_rule: Firefox only lets unsigned extensions run temporarily. Choose how to continue:
ps.ff_opt1: [1] Temporary install: works right away, but must be loaded again after every Firefox restart
ps.ff_opt2: [2] Permanent install: needs a signed .xpi (free signing at Mozilla, about 5 minutes) or Firefox Developer Edition / Nightly
ps.ff_opt3: [3] Use Edge or Chrome instead: easiest, no signing needed
ps.ff_prompt: Type 1, 2 or 3 and press Enter (Enter alone = 3)
ps.ff_temp1: 1. In the page that opened, click 'Load Temporary Add-on...'
ps.ff_temp2: 2. In the file window, press Ctrl+V to paste the path, press Enter, and pick manifest.json
ps.ff_temp3: Temporary add-ons disappear when Firefox closes. Repeat these steps next time, or choose option 2 for a permanent install.
ps.ff_perm1: I opened Mozilla's signing page and copied the path of the unsigned file:
ps.ff_perm2: 1. Sign in (free account), choose 'On your own' distribution, upload the file, and wait a few minutes for the signed .xpi
ps.ff_perm3: 2. Drag the signed .xpi into the Firefox window and click Add
ps.ff_perm4: Developer Edition / Nightly users can skip signing; see the README (Firefox section).
ps.ff_fallback: Opened {name} instead. Please sign in to claude.ai in that browser.
ps.ff_remove: Opened Firefox's add-ons page. Find 'Claude Usage Bridge', click the '...' menu, then 'Remove'.
